comments.value:
I would have edited my original post, however I have to make an addendum.

As an additional remark, this feature would also help to curate group instances. Users with the content filter enabled will not be able to join these types of group instances where the group has a content gate, even if it's considered Group Public,

Content Gating to Groups is nice.  But it would be nice to be able to create "No Minor" Public instances, since kids tend to be more of the majority of the griefers on the system.  Of course, this totally depends on VRC's ability to enforce user age accuracy, which I don't know how they can do without demanding government issued ids.
Could we expand this to bio as well ? Or Profile in general ? :)

I absolutely completely and unequivocally support this. It would make the game so, so much better if adult groups and their group instances could be completely blocked off from accounts marked as under 18.

Even if you don't run suggestive or adult themed groups, some groups want to rightfully remain 18+; for example, the two improv groups I am part of are 18+ since they don't want to have children in their improv scenes or shows (anything can happen in improv).

It would be a BOON for them to be able to easily gate access from children, and for group events to remain non-children for the safety and peace of mind of everyone involved.
This is definitely needed, and should be implemented as a priority. The prevalence of minors in adult-suggestive groups is... disturbing.

*gets up from chair*

Well, I guess this also works.

details:
I know of some VRChat groups that would benefit well from Content Gating. Please allow the ability for groups to be content gated, in addition to worlds and avatars.

Users already have an option to block a group. This automatic filter would be helpful to people who don't want to see sexually suggestive or adult themed groups. This would also prevent underage users from seeing, joining, and representing said groups.
title: Add Content Gating to Groups
